description: The bar chart compares the average performance across five datasets (NQ, TQA, zsRE, T-rex, HQA) with and without context, as well as with and without CINGS (w/ CONTEXT SUP.). The vertical axis represents the average performance, while the horizontal axis categorizes the data into four groups: "With Context," "Without Context," "Standard," and "CInGS (w/)." The "With Context" group is represented by blue bars, while the "Without Context" group is represented by purple bars. The "Standard" group is represented by a gray bar with a dotted pattern, and the "CInGS (w/)" group is represented by a solid purple bar. The average performance values range from approximately 30 to 60, with the "With Context" group showing the highest performance, followed by the "Without Context" group, the "Standard" group, and the "CInGS (w/)" group. The chart does not provide specific numerical values for each bar, but the "With Context" group appears to have the shortest bar, while the "Without Context" group has the tallest bar. The "Standard" and "CInGS (w/)" groups have bars of similar height, indicating similar performance levels. The chart does not include any additional visual emphasis or sorting of the bars.
